fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner traced the bug: Claude Code's Notification permission_prompt hook sets a session blocked/permission and no hook fires when the prompt is answered, so session.Resolve's strict hook precedence hides a newer Rex idle and session message waits until its 10m timeout. inboxItems drops every block in autonomous runs and lists only question blocks otherwise, and Stalled never counts blocked sessions, so a permission prompt never reaches the inbox. The planner raised four questions (intent served, inbox item, how a stale block clears, what session message prints while waiting). The arbiter answered with Decision permission-block-inbox-and-clear: serve milestone-30; a permission-blocked session of a live run is an inbox item of kind permission at once, autonomous runs too; a newer non-blocked Rex report clears a permission block (question and auth blocks keep strict hook precedence); session message prints to stderr why it waits and its timeout error names the last status. Three leaves follow: permission-block-clears, inbox-permission-items, message-says-why-waiting.
fields.title: Plan: permission-blocked runs in the inbox, and session message on them (autonomous)
